body.name: Ordered empirical moment vector
body.construction: On \(\{\mathbb P_N\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\}\), compute the all-active full-rank recursion \(\mathfrak R_T(\mathbb P_N)\), evaluate \(\phi_T(\xi;\mathbb P_N)\), and set \(M_N=\mathbb P_N[\phi_T(\xi;\mathbb P_N)]\); set \(M_N=0\) otherwise. Set \(M_T=P_\xi[\phi_T(\xi;P_\xi)]\).
